prompt:
A sprite sheet of 6 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 2 x 3 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) large round-crowned oak tree; 2) tall slender broadleaf tree; 3) wide leafy tree with a split trunk; 4) young tree; 5) old gnarled tree with a hollow; 6) bushy maple-like tree.
Scale: each tree is about 60-70 art pixels tall (the young tree about 46); each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels. Foliage: dense leaf clusters, deep greens with blue-violet shading and yellow-green highlights on the upper left; visible trunk and roots at the base.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt: Create a sprite sheet PNG with a truly fully transparent alpha background, six distinct upright tree props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG. Arrange in a 2-column x 3-row grid, reading order: top row left (1) large round-crowned oak tree, right (2) tall slender broadleaf tree; middle row left (3) wide leafy tree with split trunk, right (4) young smaller tree; bottom row left (5) old gnarled tree with clearly visible hollow, right (6) bushy maple-like tree. Large wide empty transparent margins between each, isolated silhouettes never touching and never clipped. All viewed from classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle: top surfaces of rounded foliage masses visible as well as their front face, upright woody trunks and roots visible at the bottom, not side-view tree illustrations. Consistent scale, mature trees around 60–70 logical art pixels high; young tree ~46. Premium hand-placed HD pixel art, each square pixel crisp with same pixel size throughout image, approximately 6–8 physical image pixels per logical art pixel; no mixed pixel sizes. Leafy foliage dense bold clusters of 3–10 pixels, with deep earthy forest greens, cooler blue-violet shading in recesses and bright muted yellow-green highlights at upper left. Brown warm yellow-highlighted bark with saturated purplish-red shadows and 4–6 clean shades per material. Deliberate solid colour clusters; no antialiasing, blur, brushes, gradients, photographic texture, noise, or checkerboard dithering. Neutral soft even upper-left overcast lighting; clean base colors without cast shadows, pools of light, night effects or glow. Absolutely no ground, no shadows, no text, no labels or numbers, no border. Transparent empty space around and between props.
